assets.initialPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production TRANSPARENT UI illustration sprite sheet for the Twilight Forest learning website. No floor, no background, no visible grid, no frames, no lettering. Consistent soft upper-left warm illumination, matte detailed materials, gently dimensional, readable at 120px. TOP LEFT: a small teal liquid glass flask beside a small brass magnifying lens and two sage leaves, science exploration. TOP MIDDLE: a closed teal magical study book with tiny brass crescent clasp, one small glass potion and contained warm star spark, learning adventures. TOP RIGHT: elegant antique brass lantern with a tiny star inside, rolled path map at base, investigation. BOTTOM LEFT: a welcoming stack of three cream and teal books with a paper scroll tied by olive ribbon, downloadable materials. BOTTOM MIDDLE: an open teacher's ledger, teal inkpot and one feather quill, no text, classroom preparation. BOTTOM RIGHT: a beautiful antique brass key laid diagonally across a sealed cream envelope, with tiny wax crescent seal, access code administration. Do not draw characters or faces.
